3.7 County Share of GCP (2013-2017)
Table 5 shows the counties’ shares of GCP for the period 2013 to 2017. Counties that are largely
dominated by urban centers, notably Nairobi City and Mombasa, have had their shares of GCP
consistently decline over the period mostly due to growth in agriculture’s contribution to gross
domestic product. On the other hand, counties with strong presence of agricultural activities,
particularly horticulture, have consistently improved their share of GCP over the period.
